facts.en: Completed a sport administration certificate at Fictional Greenglass Institute in 2022.
facts.zh: 2022 年在虚构绿玻璃学院完成体育行政证书课程。

facts.en: Paid fixtures assistant at Fictional Kitefield Community League from 2024-02 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2024-02 至 2026-08 在虚构风筝场社区联赛任有薪赛程助理。

facts.en: Maintained fixture notices for 8 adult recreational teams using the league secretary’s approved schedule.
facts.zh: 依据联赛秘书批准的赛程，维护 8 支成人休闲球队的比赛通知。

facts.en: Checked pitch availability and notified team contacts of confirmed booking windows.
facts.zh: 检查球场可用时间，并将已确认预订窗口通知球队联系人。

facts.en: Requested referee availability, followed up on unanswered requests and forwarded clashes to the appointments officer.
facts.zh: 征询裁判可用时间，跟进未回复请求，并将时间冲突转交任命专员。

facts.en: Updated cancellation notices after the league secretary or venue operator confirmed a cancellation.
facts.zh: 在联赛秘书或场地方确认取消后更新取消通知。

facts.en: The 2025 spring fixture register contained 42 scheduled matches, of which 6 were postponed and 3 were cancelled without replay.
facts.zh: 2025 年春季赛程登记表包含 42 场计划比赛，其中 6 场延期，3 场取消且未补赛。

facts.en: The register does not establish that all 42 scheduled matches were played or that every postponed match was later completed.
facts.zh: 该登记表不能确定计划中的全部 42 场比赛均已举行，或每场延期比赛后来均已完成。

facts.en: Drafted alternative dates for 4 postponed fixtures in 2025-05 after collecting team and venue availability.
facts.zh: 2025-05 收集球队及场地可用时间后，为 4 场延期比赛起草替代日期。

facts.en: The league secretary chose and approved the replacement dates; the candidate distributed the notices.
facts.zh: 联赛秘书选择并批准替代日期；候选人分发通知。

facts.en: Uses shared calendars, spreadsheet filters and a checklist for sending notices to all listed team contacts.
facts.zh: 使用共享日历、电子表格筛选及向全部所列球队联系人发送通知的核对表。

facts.en: Kept venue bookings separate from match-result submissions in the league register.
facts.zh: 在联赛登记表中将场地预订与比赛结果提交分开记录。

facts.en: Asked team contacts to confirm receipt of revised fixture notices and followed up on unanswered messages.
facts.zh: 请球队联系人确认收到修订赛程通知，并跟进未回复消息。

facts.en: Prepared a one-page fixture-change guide in 2026-01 showing who approved changes and who received the notice.
facts.zh: 2026-01 编写一页赛程变更指南，列明变更批准人及通知接收人。

facts.en: Attended an internal venue-booking briefing in 2024-02; no coaching or referee qualification was awarded.
facts.zh: 2024-02 参加内部场地预订说明会；未获颁教练或裁判资格。

facts.en: Volunteered on a water-station rota at Fictional Willowloop Fun Run for one event in 2023.
facts.zh: 2023 年在虚构柳环趣味跑的单次活动中按排班担任饮水站志愿者。

facts.en: Built a personal round-robin schedule for 5 fictional tabletop-game players in 2022.
facts.zh: 2022 年为 5 名虚构桌游玩家制作个人循环赛赛程。
爱好设计虚构球队队旗。

facts.en: No independently approved full-season allocation or league disciplinary decision is documented.
facts.zh: 未记录独立批准完整赛季安排或联赛纪律决定的经历。
